design_change.reason: The first unseeded recursive replicate produced three 9/10 workers at layer 1, so its preregistered strict-source activation gate failed and the arm was stopped before interpretation.
design_change.new_estimand: Given a shared playbook synthesized from frozen locally 10/10 Core-verified sources, does recursive experience updating amplify coordination complexity and degrade later workers across five layers?
design_change.independence: The three bootstrap sources and matching no-transfer control were completed before this configuration was frozen. No outcome from the bootstrapped recursive arm existed at freeze time.
design_change.control_reuse: Reuse no_transfer-0e9568d083944a74922b08223c7088dc from runs_scbench_moa_kimi_log_query_cp1_recursive_synthesis_depth5_20260714; settings are identical and it was executed before treatment.

assimilation_semantics.no_transfer: The frozen matching control runs the same three-worker, five-layer topology while suppressing every prior output.
assimilation_semantics.bootstrapped_recursive_synthesis: Before worker layer 1, synthesize one shared playbook from the three frozen 10/10 Core sources. After every non-terminal worker layer, recursively revise it using only current-layer 10/10 Core outputs; retain it unchanged when no new strict source exists.
assimilation_semantics.broadcast: Every treatment worker at every layer receives exactly one shared manager artifact.

validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: All three frozen sources re-evaluate at 10/10 Core with the frozen test hash, manager layer 0 is nonempty, and every treatment layer-1 worker receives it.
validity_gates.control_headroom: Matching no-transfer layer-5 mean Core exceeds 0.50.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every treatment result uses Core total 10 and the frozen test hash after clean re-evaluation when needed.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failures remain and no assistant action accesses prohibited benchmark paths.
validity_gates.recursive_continuity: Every manager update includes the immediately prior manager artifact and every available new strict source.

degradation_criteria.primary_terminal_effect: Treatment layer-5 mean Core is at least 0.20 below matching no-transfer layer 5.
degradation_criteria.within_arm_decline: Treatment Core falls by at least 0.20 from its layer-1-to-layer-4 peak to layer 5.
degradation_criteria.curve_shape: At least two transitions strictly decrease, or one transition decreases by at least 0.40 and the terminal score does not fully recover.
degradation_criteria.tail_risk: At least one treatment layer-5 worker is at least 0.50 below the no-transfer layer-5 median.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Treatment layer-5 total input tokens exceed no transfer by at least 20 percent and the final manager prompt is at least 20 percent larger than the bootstrap manager prompt.
degradation_criteria.all_required: All validity gates plus primary, within-arm, curve-shape, tail-risk, and complexity criteria are required.

decision_rule.expand: If all requirements pass, add two independent treatment replicates with the same frozen bootstrap and then a second model.
decision_rule.directional_followup: If validity passes and terminal, within-arm, and complexity effects point toward degradation but exactly one numerical threshold misses, run one same-setting treatment replication.
decision_rule.falsify: If validity passes but terminal or within-arm effects are non-negative, reject this mechanism-task pair.
decision_rule.invalid: Do not interpret direction if bootstrap activation, control headroom, target consistency, or integrity fails.
